servinfo.title: Whistling sound is heard from evaporator

condition.ptxt: Whistling sound is heard from evaporator

ps.ptxt: Depending on the combination of the interior / exterior temperatures, engine rpm and refrigerant pressure, the refrigerant flowing out of the expansion valve may generate whistling sound.

action.ptxt: Slightly decreasing amount of refrigerant may stop this noise.
Check expansion valve and replace it if faulty.
